title: Automate changelog generation and onboard Peregrine-13B v1.1 performance profiles + metadata
author: Anya Patel
release_notes: Onboarded Peregrine-13B v1.1 with canonical metadata and performance profiles. Added automated changelog generation for model registry updates to ensure release notes are generated and reviewed as part of onboarding.
description: Context: Peregrine-13B v1.1 is a new optimizer+quantized variant we're adding to the model catalog. This PR does two things: 1) adds metadata and verified performance profiles for Peregrine-13B v1.1 (through our perf harness), and 2) integrates a changelog generation step into model onboarding so release notes are produced automatically and attached to PRs. Motivation: manual changelog updates were a frequent source of omission in releases and delayed ops/marketing coordination. Automating the changelog reduces human error and ensures consistent release notes for every model onboarding. Changes: - Added peregrine-13b-v1.1 metadata JSON (schema-compliant) including model_id, family, dims, tokenizer, recommended quantization profiles, and security notes. - Added performance profiles (latency/p90, throughput on target instance types, memory/kv-cache stats) produced by the perf-lab harness and normalized into perf-profiles/*.json. - Implemented a new GitHub Action workflow .github/workflows/model-changelog.yml that:  * validates model metadata against registry schema,  * runs a lightweight perf-summary generator (against persisted perf artifacts),  * produces a markdown-formatted changelog entry in /changelogs/models/ and attaches it to the PR. - Added unit + integration tests for metadata validation and changelog generation. - Small docs update to redwood-docs describing the onboarding changelog expectations and how to override generated entries. Checklist: - [x] Metadata file added and schema-validated - [x] Perf profiles added and sanity-checked - [x] Changelog workflow implemented and tested - [x] CI passes on main and perf pipeline triggered - [x] Docs updated Impact: Onboard path now produces a consistent changelog entry that can be reviewed/edited in PRs. This should reduce errors in release notes and speed cross-team coordination (SRE/Marketing/Product). Rollout: workflow will run on model-registry PRs only; opted not to run on docs-only PRs. Backwards compatibility: existing model entries unchanged; automation only adds generated changelog drafts and validation (non-blocking for maintainers).
